findings.title: Review author and booking ownership are taken from the request body
steps: Authenticated as playerB, POST /api/v1/reviews with userId = playerA id and playerB's own booking
Authenticated as playerB, POST /api/v1/reviews for playerA's booking 1 with userId = playerB
findings.expected: 403 Forbidden — author must be the caller and must own the booking

evidence.codeEvidence: ReviewService.submitReview() uses dto.getUserId() directly; no comparison with the authenticated principal and no booking-ownership check. A 500 here is TC-005 firing on the same call path.
evidence.foreignBookingBody: The remote server returned an error: (403) Forbidden.

findings.title: Payment is simulated: no gateway, no credential capture, no verification
steps: POST /api/v1/payments/checkout {slotId, method:'CARD', applyWalletAmount:0} — note the request carries NO card number, NO account number and NO PIN
POST /api/v1/payments/checkout for a slot with no hold
findings.expected: Payment authorised by an external provider before the booking is confirmed

evidence.requestContract: CheckoutRequest has exactly three fields: slotId, method (BKASH|NAGAD|CARD|CASH), applyWalletAmount. No PAN/account/PIN/OTP field exists, so the bKash sheet in the UI cannot be transmitting anything.
evidence.noHoldBody: The remote server returned an error: (409) Conflict.

findings.title: AdminPartBDataSeeder never executes (@PostConstruct runs before CommandLineRunner)
steps: Inspect AdminPartBDataSeeder: seeding is triggered from @PostConstruct
Part A (users/venues/pitches) is created by CommandLineRunner beans, which run AFTER all @PostConstruct callbacks
Start the app and read the log; then GET /api/v1/admin/payouts
findings.expected: Seeded bookings, payouts and audit logs exist for admin analytics
findings.actual: backend log says 'Cannot run Part B Seeder: required Part A data (Users/Venues/Pitches) is missing.'; GET /admin/payouts returned 200 with 0 rows

evidence.consequence: Admin payouts, 12-month GMV history and audit-log demo data are always empty, so admin analytics fall back to fabricated values.
evidence.logLine: Cannot run Part B Seeder: required Part A data (Users/Venues/Pitches) is missing.
